lens: August opened with a healthcare-heavy signing wave — three multi-billion-dollar processes (KKR/Integer, Curium/Lantheus, Supernus/Indivior) plus two definitive proxies — against a firm tape where the day’s real constraint was execution capacity, not deal supply.

stories.headline: Goldman advises Integer on its ~$5.7B take-private by KKR; Centerview, Barclays, Citi and Raymond James advise KKR
stories.why_it_matters: KKR agreed to acquire Integer Holdings (NYSE: ITGR) — a leading medical-device contract developer/manufacturer (CDMO) — in an all-cash deal at $127.00/share, ~$5.7B enterprise value (a ~51.8% premium to Integer’s Apr 29 unaffected price), following a board-led strategic review. The release names Goldman Sachs as Integer’s exclusive financial adviser (sell-side); Centerview Partners, Barclays, Citi and Raymond James advise KKR (buy-side); Citi, KKR Capital Markets, Barclays, UBS and Jefferies are lead arrangers on the debt financing. A sponsor take-private of a regulated device maker runs lender-syndicate, FDA/quality-system and confirmatory diligence to close.
stories.suggested_action: Open with Goldman (Integer) and the KKR adviser group (Centerview / Barclays / Citi / Raymond James) — a ~$5.7B device-CDMO take-private runs lender-group, regulatory and confirmatory diligence a secure room is built for.

deal_clock.event: KKR agrees to acquire Integer at $127/share (~$5.7B)

stories.headline: Morgan Stanley and BofA advise Lantheus; Jefferies, JPMorgan and PJT advise Curium on the up-to-$8.0B take-private
stories.why_it_matters: Curium (the CapVest-backed radiopharmaceutical group) agreed to acquire and take private Lantheus Holdings (Nasdaq: LNTH) for up to $114.50/share — $102.50 cash at closing plus up to $12.00 in CVRs tied to commercial milestones — an aggregate transaction value up to $8.0B (a 38% premium to the 60-day VWAP). The release names Morgan Stanley as lead financial adviser to Lantheus with BofA Securities and Solomon Partners (sell-side); Jefferies as lead adviser to Curium with J.P. Morgan and PJT Partners (buy-side). A cross-border radiopharma combination with a CVR runs milestone-tracking, antitrust and confirmatory diligence toward a 1H 2027 close.
stories.suggested_action: Engage Morgan Stanley / BofA (Lantheus) and Jefferies / JPMorgan / PJT (Curium) — an up-to-$8.0B CVR-structured take-private runs milestone and regulatory diligence a secure room organizes.

deal_clock.event: Curium agrees to acquire Lantheus (up to $114.50/share; up to $8.0B)

stories.headline: Jefferies and Piper Sandler advise Indivior, Wells Fargo advises Supernus on their all-stock merger of equals (~$2.2B combined revenue)
stories.why_it_matters: Supernus Pharmaceuticals (Nasdaq: SUPN) and Indivior Pharmaceuticals (Nasdaq: INDV) agreed to combine in a tax-free all-stock merger of equals, creating a diversified CNS biopharmaceutical company with ~$2.2B combined annual revenue and $125M of expected cost synergies; the combined company keeps the Supernus name and SUPN ticker, and Indivior holders receive a $1.0B special cash dividend (1.5401 exchange ratio). The release names Cantor Fitzgerald (lead) and Wells Fargo as advisers to Supernus; Jefferies and Piper Sandler as joint advisers to Indivior, with Citi also advising Indivior and Citibank providing a $650M term loan. A merger of equals runs dual-company diligence, S-4 registration and integration workstreams.
stories.suggested_action: Reach out to Wells Fargo (Supernus) and Jefferies / Piper Sandler / Citi (Indivior) — an all-stock MoE runs dual-company confirmatory diligence and S-4 workstreams a secure room keeps organized.

deal_clock.event: Supernus and Indivior agree to all-stock merger of equals

stories.headline: Evercore and Goldman advise Arcosa’s board as it files a definitive proxy for its $150/share cash sale to CRH
stories.why_it_matters: Arcosa (NYSE: ACA) filed a definitive proxy (DEFM14A) on Aug 3 for its all-cash acquisition by CRH Americas at $150.00/share, with a special stockholder meeting set for Sep 4, 2026. The filing names Evercore and Goldman Sachs as financial advisers to the Arcosa board. A signed public-company sale moving to a shareholder vote runs SEC-review, financing and confirmatory diligence through close — the window where secure-room activity peaks.
stories.suggested_action: Note Evercore/Goldman (Arcosa) — a signed $150/share cash sale heading to a Sep 4 vote runs SEC-review and confirmatory diligence a data room supports through close.

deal_clock.event: Arcosa signs merger agreement with CRH Americas

stories.headline: Stocks open August higher — S&P +0.7%, Dow +1.1% — as the 10Y eases to ~4.69% and advisory names steady after last week’s slide
stories.why_it_matters: US equities opened August broadly higher: S&P 500 +0.7% (~7,540), Nasdaq +0.9% (~25,593), Dow +1.1% (~53,060), with the VIX steady near 16.0 and the 10Y Treasury easing to ~4.69%. The advisory complex, which slid three straight sessions into month-end, steadied — Goldman -0.8%, Evercore -1.6%, Jefferies roughly flat. A firm tape and a heavy Aug 3 signing day (two multi-billion healthcare take-privates plus a CNS merger of equals) reinforce that signed processes keep moving regardless of adviser-stock swings.
stories.suggested_action: Frame outreach around execution certainty — a busy signing day against a firm-but-choppy tape means clients want live processes on schedule; room readiness protects the timeline into August.
